chapters.name: Physical World & Measurement
chapters.theory: Physics is the study of nature and natural phenomena. SI system has 7 base units: meter (length), kilogram (mass), second (time), ampere (current), kelvin (temperature), candela (luminous intensity), mole (amount of substance).

chapters.name: Kinematics
chapters.theory: Kinematics deals with motion without considering forces. For uniform acceleration: v = u + at, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as. In projectile motion, range R = u²sin(2θ)/g, max height H = u²sin²θ/(2g).

chapters.name: Newton's Laws of Motion
chapters.theory: Newton's First Law: Inertia. Second Law: F = ma (Force = mass × acceleration). Third Law: Action-Reaction. Friction f = μN, where μ is coefficient of friction. Centripetal force F = mv²/r.

chapters.name: Work, Energy & Power
chapters.theory: Work W = F·s (dot product). Kinetic Energy KE = ½mv². Potential Energy PE = mgh (gravitational). Power P = W/t = F·v. Work-Energy Theorem: Work done = Change in KE.
